cards.headline: Appeals court appears skeptical of Trump's private-records claim
cards.summary: A federal appeals court heard arguments on whether the 1978 Presidential Records Act is unconstitutional, as Trump's lawyers contend. Washington Examiner reports the judges pressed hard against that argument. No ruling has been issued.

cards.summary: Zelenskyy said the waiver would embolden Russia as it strikes Ukraine's power plants. Trump told Congress the pause serves the national interest without giving details. Republican Sen. Thom Tillis called the move 'beyond irresponsible.'
cards.why_it_matters: US sanctions policy shapes pressure on Moscow and the balance of the war, with bipartisan disagreement in Congress.

sources.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold

cards.headline: Zelenskyy calls Starlink limits in Ukraine a 'planned operation'
cards.summary: Zelenskyy said Ukraine's use of the Musk-owned satellite system remains partly restricted despite earlier signs of full restoration. He said the limits apply only in Ukraine and hamper efforts to intercept Russian drone attacks.
cards.why_it_matters: A US company's network underpins Ukraine's air defense, and the dispute tests how Washington and allies share responsibility for it.

sources.title: Zelenskyy says Starlink speed limits in Ukraine are a ‘planned operation’
Zelensky says Musk-owned satellite system still restricted in Ukraine

cards.headline: Russian strikes kill at least eight and injure nearly 60 in Ukraine
cards.summary: The latest wave of Russian strikes across Ukraine killed at least eight people and injured nearly 60, Al Jazeera reports. Attacks have continued on the country's power plants.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on energy infrastructure ahead of winter raise humanitarian stakes and pressure on Western support.

sources.title: Russian strikes kill civilians, injure dozens across Ukraine

cards.headline: Protests spread across France as students and unions rally
cards.summary: Demonstrators gathered in Paris and other cities over rising living costs, with students, teachers, unions and yellow vest members joining. NPR reports scuffles and fires, and Al Jazeera reports clashes with police, as the fiscal crisis deepens.
cards.why_it_matters: Unrest in the euro area's second-largest economy adds to political and fiscal strain in a major US ally and trade partner.

sources.title: Scuffles and fires break out as protesters rally across France, joining students

cards.headline: Swinney says SNP's second independence campaign 'has already begun'
cards.summary: Scotland's First Minister John Swinney told the SNP conference the party will use a six-figure war chest to renew the case for leaving the UK, and described a nationwide campaign effort.
cards.why_it_matters: A renewed Scottish independence push could reshape the UK, a key US ally and trading partner.

sources.title: SNP says campaign for next referendum on independence ‘has already begun’

cards.headline: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital after lung cancer surgery
cards.summary: Pope Leo, 71, left Rome's Gemelli Hospital four days after surgery that removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is due to give the Angelus blessing Sunday and is scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.
cards.why_it_matters: The recovery eases concern about Vatican leadership and clears the way for planned travel by the first American pope.

sources.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery

cards.headline: Meta removes terms that may have allowed scraping of news sites
cards.summary: After backlash, Meta updated its commercial terms to remove language suggesting it could use content from websites, including news sites, to train its AI.
cards.why_it_matters: The reversal shows publishers' pushback on AI training with their content, an unsettled issue for copyright and the web.

sources.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites

cards.headline: Ilhan Omar's lawyers demand return of items seized in home search
cards.summary: Attorneys for the Minnesota Democrat say the federal search of her home was 'neither justified nor lawful' and violated safeguards for members of Congress. They asked the Justice Department to return property and preserve recordings. House Majority Whip Tom Emmer said she should face jail if fraud is proven.
cards.why_it_matters: The dispute tests how law enforcement can search a sitting lawmaker's property, with a criminal probe and midterm politics in play.

sources.title: Ilhan Omar’s attorneys say federal search of her home was ‘neither justified nor lawful’

cards.headline: Vance hints at disagreement with Trump over Iran war
cards.summary: In an interview, Vice President JD Vance publicly hinted at breaking with Trump over the Iran war, according to the Washington Examiner, which described it as a signal of a White House split. The war nears the eight-month mark.
cards.why_it_matters: Differences inside the administration could affect US war strategy and the course of talks with Iran.

sources.title: Vance publicly hints at his disagreement with Trump over Iran war

cards.headline: US and Iran both claim control of Hormuz as mines hit two vessels
cards.summary: Two vessels have been struck by naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz this week, and both the US and Iran say they control the waterway, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Hormuz carries a large share of the world's oil, so attacks there push up fuel prices for Americans.

sources.title: US and Iran both claim control of Strait of Hormuz amid attacks on vessels

cards.headline: Egypt's Sisi seeks authorization to defend Saudi Arabia if asked
cards.summary: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi pledged 'any measure' to help defend Saudi Arabia 'if it is requested of us' and sought authorization for defense assistance.
cards.why_it_matters: Regional powers lining up behind Riyadh signal a widening Gulf conflict that threatens oil supply.

sources.title: Egypt’s Sisi seeks authorisation for defence assistance to Saudi Arabia

cards.headline: UAE to re-enter Yemen conflict as Houthis encircle Taiz
cards.summary: The UAE reportedly agreed with Saudi Arabia to resume payments to Yemeni forces as Iran-backed Houthi gains alarm Gulf rulers. The Financial Times reports Houthi forces have surrounded the city of Taiz.
cards.why_it_matters: Escalation in Yemen adds to Gulf instability and risks to shipping and energy markets.

sources.title: UAE agrees with Saudi Arabia to re-enter Yemen conflict amid Houthi gains

cards.headline: Settler attacks hit Palestinians after rabbi's olive ruling
cards.summary: Al Jazeera reports a child and four women were among Palestinians injured in West Bank attacks following a ruling by a hardline Israeli rabbi permitting seizure of Palestinian olives. Palestinians condemned the ruling.
cards.why_it_matters: Rising West Bank violence during the harvest complicates US diplomacy and fuels regional tension.

sources.title: Child, four women among Palestinians injured in West Bank pogroms
Hardline Israeli rabbi ruling on stolen Palestinian olives prompts uproar

cards.headline: Thousands rally in Tunisia in biggest protest in years against Saied
cards.summary: Unions and opposition groups joined to protest poor living conditions and restrictions on political freedoms under President Kais Saied, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Mass dissent in Tunisia signals strain in North Africa, a region tied to migration and Mediterranean security.

sources.title: Thousands rally for biggest protest in years against Tunisia’s Saied

cards.headline: Sudan's army claims dozens of RSF fighters killed in Nyala attack
cards.summary: Sudan's army says it killed dozens of Rapid Support Forces fighters in Nyala. The RSF accuses the army of killing 30 civilians at a busy livestock market. The claims are not independently confirmed.
cards.why_it_matters: Sudan's war continues to cause civilian deaths and hunger, with limited international attention.

sources.title: Sudan’s army claims dozens of RSF fighters killed in Nyala attack

cards.headline: Hurricane Trudy heads toward Mexico's Pacific coast
cards.summary: Trudy is threatening heavy rain in Mexico, the latest in successive storms to hit the country's Pacific coast this year, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Repeated storms threaten coastal communities and tourism popular with Americans.

sources.title: Hurricane Trudy makes its way towards Mexico, threatening heavy rain

cards.headline: Finance leaders walk out of IMF session as Russia's minister speaks
cards.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey was among finance leaders who left an IMF session in Bangkok when Russia's finance minister addressed the group, in protest at Russian involvement.
cards.why_it_matters: The walkout shows how the Ukraine war still divides global financial institutions, even as US sanctions policy shifts.

sources.title: Bank of England governor walks out of IMF summit in protest against Russia

cards.headline: Chinese nursery owner jailed for life over poisoned children
cards.summary: A nursery owner in China received a life sentence after hundreds of children were poisoned. She and five staff were found to have used inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing, the BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The case highlights food safety enforcement in China, with a harsh sentence aimed at public anger.

sources.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned

cards.headline: Japan's Takaichi says she will attend APEC in China if parliament allows
cards.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said she plans to attend the APEC leaders summit hosted by China if parliament permits, despite a deep freeze in ties between the two countries.
cards.why_it_matters: A Japan-China meeting could ease tension between two big US trading partners in Asia.

sources.title: Japan’s Takaichi to Attend APEC in China if Parliament Allows

cards.headline: Tech sector has worst week in 18 months as average stock gains
cards.summary: The S&P 500's tech sector had its worst week in a year and a half, while an equal-weighted version of the index posted a second straight weekly gain as leadership moved away from tech.
cards.why_it_matters: Retirement accounts weighted toward big tech felt the drop, while broader stocks held up.

sources.title: It was another great week for the average stock as market leadership shifts away from tech

cards.headline: CoreWeave troubles risk closing the junk-bond market to AI firms
cards.summary: Junk bond buyers are increasingly freezing out tech startups seeking financing as CoreWeave's difficulties raise questions about how AI companies will fund themselves, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Tighter credit for AI builders could slow data center spending that has driven the stock market and parts of the economy.

sources.title: CoreWeave Woes Risk Shutting Down AI Junk Market: Credit Weekly

cards.headline: Fed's October decision may be a closer call than markets think
cards.summary: MarketWatch lays out arguments against a Fed rate hike this month and why some economists disagree. Kalshi odds put a hold at 87% and a 25 basis point hike at 14%.
cards.why_it_matters: A hike would raise borrowing costs further for mortgages and loans, with 30-year rates already at 7.40%.

sources.title: Fed interest-rate decision this month is a closer call than markets think

cards.headline: Silver's 50% drop from record high may signal slowdown, MarketWatch says
cards.summary: Silver has fallen more than 50% from a record high earlier this year. MarketWatch says the commodity can offer hints about the economy's direction and that the drop suggests a slowdown looms.
cards.why_it_matters: Commodity moves are one input investors watch for signs of a weakening economy.

sources.title: Silver’s recent 50% drop from a record high hints that an economic slowdown looms

cards.headline: Health insurance premiums set to spike next month
cards.summary: The Hill reports Americans face significantly higher premiums next month, whether on Affordable Care Act plans or employer coverage. Some premiums could be the highest in decades, and others will pay more through copays or deductibles.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher health costs hit household budgets and are emerging as a midterm election issue.

sources.title: Health insurance is the sleeper midterms issue: Why premiums are spiking

cards.headline: Newsom orders review of AI kill switches and other safeguards
cards.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed an executive order to examine kill switches for AI models and other measures he had earlier vetoed, Al Jazeera reports. The article links the move to his possible 2028 presidential run.
cards.why_it_matters: California rules often set the pattern for national AI regulation, affecting the tech industry and consumers.

sources.title: California Gov Newsom boosts AI regulation as he eyes 2028 presidential run

cards.headline: Websites are increasingly blocking AI agents
cards.summary: As OpenAI, Meta, Google and others promote AI agents that shop, book and manage email, many websites are closing their doors to them, The Verge reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Blocks could limit what AI assistants can do for users and reshape how the web works.

sources.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents

cards.headline: SpaceX plans to become a major US wireless carrier
cards.summary: SpaceX agreed last week to buy a large block of low-band spectrum to expand Starlink, part of a plan to become a major wireless carrier. An analyst on The Verge podcast calls it ambitious and expensive.
cards.why_it_matters: A new national carrier could challenge AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon on mobile service prices.

sources.title: SpaceX’s ambitious, expensive gamble to replace AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon

cards.headline: Musk agrees to settle lawsuits over 2024 election lottery
cards.summary: Elon Musk and America PAC said they agreed to settle two proposed class actions alleging he defrauded residents over a promise to give $1 million a day to petition signers. Terms were not given in the summary.
cards.why_it_matters: The settlements close a legal fight over campaign giveaways in the 2024 election.

sources.title: Elon Musk agrees to settle lawsuits over 2024 election lottery

cards.headline: More Democrats report threatening letters claiming to be from DSA
cards.summary: Rep. Hillary Scholten, a Michigan Democrat, said she received a threatening letter claiming to be from the Democratic Socialists of America, joining other lawmakers and election officials who reported similar letters. She condemned political intimidation.
cards.why_it_matters: Threats against officials during early voting raise security concerns for the midterms.

sources.title: Centrist Democrat Hillary Scholten says she received ‘threatening letter’ claiming to be from DSA

cards.summary: NPR reports Trump promised a swing-district blitz but is visiting several states he won easily two years ago. NPR says that shows a tougher landscape for Republicans. Politico reports some GOP candidates are avoiding Trump in ads.

cards.headline: Kansas Senate race becomes a Republican worry, Politico reports
cards.summary: Politico reports Kansas has become a newly competitive Senate race that is causing headaches for Republicans, and Sen. Roger Marshall is struggling.
cards.why_it_matters: A competitive seat in a reliably red state widens the fight for Senate control.

sources.title: A sleeper Senate battleground has turned into a real Republican liability

cards.why_it_matters: Large protests days before early voting show how activism is feeding into midterm campaigns.

sources.title: Final Trump arch plans submitted to city omit proposed military complex

cards.headline: Solar boom in Philippines as Iran war lifts energy costs
cards.summary: With Southeast Asia's largest electricity bills rising further, Filipinos are investing in rooftop solar panels, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The war's energy shock is changing power choices abroad, part of the same price pressure Americans see at the pump.

sources.title: Solar power booms in Philippines as war on Iran spikes energy costs

cards.summary: Individual investors and second-home buyers made up one in five home purchases in September, the highest share in a little over a year, as mortgage rates sit near 7%, MarketWatch reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Cash-rich buyers can crowd out first-time buyers when borrowing costs are high.

sources.title: Meet the home buyers totally unfazed by 7% mortgage rates

cards.headline: Dozens of endangered orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfires
cards.summary: Rescuers in Indonesia have saved dozens of critically endangered orangutans during a deadly wildfire season, NPR reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Wildfires threaten one of the world's most endangered primates and Southeast Asian forests.

sources.title: Dozens of critically endangered orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfires

cards.headline: Study finds microplastics react with water, a concern for biology
cards.summary: A new study says tiny plastic pieces, normally considered inert, can react with water, one of the most pervasive molecules in the environment and in the body, Wired reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The finding adds to questions about how microplastics affect human health.

sources.title: Microplastics React With Water, a New Study Says. That’s a Problem for Biology

cards.headline: Musk says AI and robots must solve the national debt
cards.summary: Elon Musk told biographer Walter Isaacson the DOGE experiment showed there was no way to solve the deficit from within government, and that only AI and robots can address the national debt.

cards.summary: Stellantis' chief engineering officer Ned Curic plans to keep hiring engineers as the automaker rolls out dozens of new models in its turnaround plan, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Hiring by a major automaker with large US operations points to investment in new models.

sources.title: Stellantis Plans to Hire Hundreds More Engineers in Europe, US

cards.headline: Florida man, 71, killed by 12-foot alligator while fishing
cards.summary: Steve Hamilton, 71, was fishing at a pond in Winter Garden, Florida, when an almost 12-foot alligator attacked and killed him on Friday, authorities and media reports said. The animal was later killed.

cards.summary: Five days of clashes in Tirana continued Saturday as students joined a wider movement demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation. Police fired rubber bullets, and protesters allege police brutality outside the Education Ministry.

cards.summary: At least 17 people died and many more were injured in a stampede at a religious gathering in north Kolkata, West Bengal, police said. Large crowds and rain were cited.

cards.summary: TikTok permanently banned the advertising account for Alex Gibney's four-hour Musk documentary, the distributor Bleecker Street was told Friday, ahead of the film's wider release. TikTok did not immediately comment.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how platform ad rules can shape what reaches viewers, here involving one of the world's best-known executives.

cards.summary: Hundreds of protesters gathered outside the office of Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko on Saturday, demanding that he step down. The report did not give their specific grievances.
cards.why_it_matters: Domestic political friction in wartime Ukraine comes as Kyiv faces power-plant strikes and uncertain US support.

sources.title: Hundreds rally in Kyiv to demand the resignation of Mayor Vitali Klitschko

cards.summary: Israeli drone attacks killed six Palestinians across Gaza on Saturday, Al Jazeera reported. UNICEF says more than 340 children have been killed since the ceasefire began a year ago.
cards.why_it_matters: The year-old ceasefire remains fragile, affecting regional diplomacy and humanitarian conditions.

sources.title: Israeli drone attacks kill six Palestinians across Gaza despite ‘ceasefire’

cards.summary: An ITV undercover investigation recorded a would-be Reform UK MP saying Muslims could not be British and asylum seekers should be put in 'concentration camps', the Guardian reports. Reform's response was not included in the summary.
cards.why_it_matters: It bears on UK politics, where immigration is a central issue and a close US ally's politics are shifting.

sources.title: Reform candidate filmed saying asylum seekers should be put in ‘concentration camps’

cards.summary: The Hill reports that annual CPI inflation rose from 3.4 percent in August to 3.7 percent in September, per the Bureau of Labor Statistics, adding pressure on Republicans as early voting begins.
cards.why_it_matters: Rising prices are a top voter concern and may shape turnout and congressional control on Nov. 3.

cards.summary: The Washington Examiner reports Graham Platner's campaign has spent about $2.3 million since July, paying severance to his wife and staff, with no contributions to Troy Jackson, who replaced him, or to Maine Democrats.

cards.summary: Trump spoke at a Highland Heights, Kentucky, rally for House candidate Ed Gallrein and other Republicans. He plans a seven-day, seven-stop campaign tour, including Michigan on Oct. 25, before the Nov. 3 elections.

cards.headline: Iranian TV airs video said to show tanker exploding in Hormuz
cards.summary: Iranian state TV aired footage it said shows an oil tanker exploding after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. The footage was not independently verified in the report.
cards.why_it_matters: Shipping risk in Hormuz is a key driver of oil prices and US gasoline costs.

sources.title: Iranian TV airs video said to show tanker explosion in Hormuz

cards.headline: Reporter spends afternoon with $55,000 humanoid housekeepers
cards.summary: MarketWatch tested two Tau Robotics humanoids that vacuumed and wiped counters, with some help from humans operating behind the scenes.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how far home humanoid robots are from fully autonomous chores, and what early adopters would pay.

sources.title: Can a $55,000 robot load the dishwasher? Inside my afternoon with two humanoid housekeepers.

cards.summary: Anthropic reported its workforce composition and the kind of work being done have changed significantly over the past year, with employees less junior and spending more time in meetings.
cards.why_it_matters: It offers a rare look at how AI firms, and possibly AI-assisted work, reshape staffing and entry-level jobs.

sources.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings

cards.why_it_matters: License plate readers are spreading across US cities; the feature gives drivers visibility into where they are tracked.

sources.title: MapQuest's new 'surveillance layer' feature flags Flock cameras on users' routes

cards.summary: New Scientist reports that wearing noise-cancelling headphones on the operating table reduced the risk of nausea and vomiting after surgery, which may relate to noise exposure even under general anaesthetic.
cards.why_it_matters: A cheap, low-risk intervention could ease a common and unpleasant recovery problem for surgical patients.

sources.title: Noise-cancelling headphones prevent vomiting after surgery

cards.summary: Justice Samuel Alito began his 22nd Supreme Court term, insisting he will stay on the bench, but speculation about a possible retirement has grown, the Washington Examiner reports.
cards.why_it_matters: A vacancy would give the president and Senate a chance to reshape the court shortly after the midterms.

sources.title: Why speculation about Justice Alito’s future continues despite his rejection of retirement

cards.headline: Berkshire backs Bending Spoons, a new software consolidator
cards.summary: Less than four months after going public, Bending Spoons received a vote of confidence from Berkshire Hathaway this week, CNBC reports. The company buys and revives older software businesses.
cards.why_it_matters: Berkshire's interest in software comes during a tech selloff and signals where some investors see value.

sources.title: Software’s new consolidator gets big vote of confidence from Berkshire

sources.title: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
